name: memento
description: Multi-layer cache memory base. L3 (sources) -> L2 (wiki) -> L1 (AGENTS.md) compilation pipeline with a hardened deterministic eval gate (source evidence proves provenance; compiled answer surfaces must contain required atoms; ungated runs are explicit), health checks, passive session capture (save, with structured trajectory telemetry), active LLM-driven interview (ama), lightweight follow-up queue review (followups), and gated promotion of local skills/tools to a marketplace git repo, defaulting to the active Memento/RSI target (promote — sole writer of the promotion ledger, composes actuary --tier as static Gate-1 through harness-native skill invocation or direct workflow fallback). Knowledge base only; task storage is an explicit root-level opt-in.
